data.name: TrainSim: Point & Call
data.detailed_description:
Key Features

  • Three handcrafted routes: one modern metro line and two distinct high-speed railway lines, spanning dense urban cores to long intercity stretches. Master varying speed limits, signals, and station operations across each route.

  • Realistic driving model: traction and coasting, regenerative and emergency braking, gradients and curves, adhesion dynamics, and meter-perfect stopping challenges.

  • Timetables and scoring: follow strict arrival/departure times, speed limits, and signals. Earn ratings based on punctuality, passenger comfort, braking smoothness, and platform alignment.

  • Immersive cabs: Faithfully recreated instruments and indicators.

  • Dynamic environments: adjustable weather and day-night cycle. Rain and snow affect braking distance and visibility; passenger flow varies by time of day to change rhythm and difficulty.

  • Tutorials and challenges: from beginner operations to advanced scenarios (precision stops, strict speed control, harsh weather) that build professional-grade skills step by step.

Route Highlights

  • Metro Line: short station spacing and frequent stop–start action test your acceleration–braking flow and platform accuracy. Peak-hour timetables leave little margin for error.

  • High-Speed Line A: long sections and high speed limits demand anticipation of gradients and speed changes to keep perfect time without sacrificing ride comfort.

  • High-Speed Line B: tunnels, bridges, and complex turnouts with frequent signal and speed transitions—ideal for seasoned drivers seeking a challenge.

data.short_description: Find the sweet spot between speed and precision as you step into the driver’s seat and run trains across cities and vast landscapes. The game focuses on authentic handling and time management, delivering a tight, goal-driven, fully immersive cab experience.
data.supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB or equivalent, DirectX 12 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: VR not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT or higher, DirectX 12
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: VR not supported
